column2: - Object type (G, GX, GC, OC, NB, PN, DN, RN, C+N, HA, HII, SNR, BN, EN, SA, SC, RG, CL, IG, QSO or empty)
- VdB number (Van den Bergh Catalogue of reflection nebulae)
- RCW number (A catalogue of Hα-emission regions in the southern Milky Way)
- LDN number (Lynds' Catalogue of Dark Nebulae)
- LBN number (Lynds' Catalogue of Bright Nebulae)
- Mel number (Melotte Catalogue of Deep Sky Objects)
- PGC number (HYPERLEDA. I. Catalog of galaxies)
- UGC number (The Uppsala General Catalogue of Galaxies)
- Ced number (Cederblad Catalog of bright diffuse Galactic nebulae)
- VV number (The catalogue of interacting galaxies by Vorontsov-Velyaminov)
- PK identificator (Catalogue of Galactic Planetary Nebulae)
- PN G identificator (Strasbourg-ESO Catalogue of Galactic Planetary Nebulae)
- SNR G identificator (A catalogue of Galactic supernova remnants)
- ACO number (Rich Clusters of Galaxies by Abell et. al.)
- HCG identificator (Hickson Compact Group by Hickson P.)
- ESO identificator (ESO/Uppsala survey of the ESO(B) atlas by Lauberts)
- VdBH identificator (Van den Bergh and Herbst; Catalogue of southern stars embedded in nebulosity)
- DWB number (Catalogue and distances of optically visible H II regions)
